timelineEvents.title: Bick & Kaper at Berlin premiere
timelineEvents.label: 1929 · Bick & Kaper at Berlin premiere
timelineEvents.shortDescription: The Bick und Kaper piano duo plays at a Berlin film premiere and attracts press attention.
timelineEvents.longDescription: The jazz piano duo Bick und Kaper performs at the Ufa-Theater "Universum" in Berlin, opening the premiere of "Der Adjutant des Zaren." The Rhein- und Ruhrzeitung writes: "Their technique is astonishing."
